name: Point-based Isosurface Extraction with Octree Pruning
definition: A view-dependent algorithm that divides the model into grid cells until sub-pixel resolution is achieved, using point primitives to represent smaller triangles.
summary: Point-based Isosurface Extraction with Octree Pruning is a view-dependent method that recursively subdivides scalar fields into point primitives until sub-pixel resolution, using octree pruning for efficient interactive rendering of large unstructured grids.
